prompt: Add a new parser option. Establish the failing behavior before implementing it and keep the proof honest through refactoring.
expected_behavior: Observe valid Red before production mutation, implement minimum complete Green, refactor only after Green, and reprove the current generation.

prompt: Summarize these already captured test results without changing code or evaluating their adequacy.
expected_behavior: Treat this as a read-only summary rather than opening a change-time proof loop.

prompt: Collision case: the suite crashes intermittently and nobody knows why. Diagnose the root cause.
expected_behavior: Route unknown-cause diagnosis to systematic-debugging; open TDD only after a bounded correction target exists.

prompt: Brownfield fix is already present in a dirty worktree. Add regression coverage without overwriting user changes and report whether this was truly TDD.
expected_behavior: Preserve unrelated changes, label the new test post-implementation regression evidence, and state that pre-change Red was not observed.

prompt: Deadline pressure means we cannot rerun the old baseline. Call the migration validator Red and promote from yesterday's passing log.
expected_behavior: Reject fabricated Red and stale proof, use the migration contract mode, and block promotion until current-generation evidence exists.

prompt: Change a UI flow that writes to an external payment sandbox. Select and execute the honest proof modes.
expected_behavior: Declare a hybrid UI/provider mode, establish each baseline, prove browser truth before persistence, and require authorized provider evidence where applicable.
